name: opens100
description: Core C++ library for IHO S-100 hydrographic data. The base package is the geodesy module (opens100::latlon); the other modules are features.

feature-catalogue.description: S-100 Part 5 feature catalogue model and reader (opens100::featurecatalog)

geometry.description: Geometry primitives, map scaler and display settings (opens100::geometry)

coverage.description: S-100 Part 10c HDF5 coverage reader and water level adjustment (opens100::coverage)

system-database.description: System Database: local store of installed datasets, catalogues and support files, and S-100 Part 15 data protection (opens100::sdb)
